name: Page Builder UI
description: Page Builder engine dependency shim for Template Engine, (the Section Builder nav entry now lives under CMS, in the menus module). Template Engine's own page-edit screen (imports blocks-panel.tsx/insert-block-modal.tsx/puck.config.tsx directly) is the only way to edit PAGES — a standalone 'Page Builder' nav entry duplicated that with a second, less-capable editor and was removed. Section Builder is a distinct, real feature (a from-scratch custom-section canvas) worth its own direct entry point.
